name: What are signs that my water heater needs maintenance or replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are signs that my water heater needs maintenance or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your water heater may need attention. These include a lack of hot water, rust-colored or cloudy water, strange noises like rumbling or popping from the tank, and visible leaks around the unit. A drop in efficiency, leading to higher energy bills, can also be a symptom. While some issues can be resolved with maintenance like flushing the tank, persistent problems or an old unit (typically over 10-15 years) often point to a need for replacement. Ignoring these signs can lead to breakdowns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs your water heater needs maintenance or replacement include no hot water, discolored water, strange noises, leaks, or decreased efficiency.
